summary.text: Carey Coleman is the Republican nominee in Ohio's 13th Congressional District and a Northeast Ohio broadcaster. According to his campaign website, he has been a longtime radio host on WNIR and a television meteorologist, and he is running on fiscal discipline, secure borders and support for law enforcement.

paragraphs.text: According to his campaign website, Coleman is a longtime Northeast Ohio radio host and community leader known for his commentary on WNIR.

The site says he served for decades as a television meteorologist on national, statewide and local Northeast Ohio outlets, and WVXU likewise describes him as a former WNIR-FM talk show host who worked as a meteorologist nationally and in Cleveland.

Coleman won the May 5, 2026 Republican primary for Ohio's 13th District with 47.3% of the vote, ahead of Kevin Siembida, Margaret Briem, Neil Patel and Sanjin Drakovac, and he faces Democratic Rep. Emilia Sykes in the November general election.
His campaign website says he lives in Northeast Ohio and is involved in local civic life and charitable causes, and his campaign committee lists a Macedonia, Ohio, address.
